title: Classic, beautiful design
text: Classic, beautiful design. Who doesn't love the durability of corning ware?  I just bought a "tiny" home and I am older... so the durability, the lightweight pieces and small space requirements are all determining factors for me.  The basic, classic black and white design works for me.  I didn't know if I would like the solid black mugs, but they are actually quite nice.  I chose this design because you could mix and match with the plain white if I wanted to, or for serving pieces.  I always update my reviews if useful info comes to light, but honestly corning ware is pretty much bullet proof.
